usage: llm-modelbench context-profile [-h] --model MODEL
                                      [--runtime-profile RUNTIME_PROFILE]
                                      [--run-id RUN_ID] [--runs-dir RUNS_DIR]
                                      [--rankings-out RANKINGS_OUT]
                                      [--cards-out CARDS_OUT]
                                      [--target-ctx TARGET_CTX]
                                      [--gpu-vram-gb GPU_VRAM_GB]
                                      [--emergency-headroom-gb EMERGENCY_HEADROOM_GB]
                                      [--max-spill-gb MAX_SPILL_GB]
                                      [--min-tps MIN_TPS]
                                      [--critical-tps CRITICAL_TPS]
                                      [--live-ui {off,compact,full,graph,log}]
                                      [--behavior-probe] [--no-behavior-probe]
                                      [--yes] [--mock] [--no-ranking-update]
                                      [--separate-ranking]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --model MODEL         exact installed Ollama model name
  --runtime-profile RUNTIME_PROFILE
                        saved runtime profile; explicit selection takes
                        precedence
  --run-id RUN_ID
  --runs-dir RUNS_DIR
  --rankings-out RANKINGS_OUT
                        rankings directory refreshed after the profile;
                        default: rankings
  --cards-out CARDS_OUT
  --target-ctx TARGET_CTX
  --gpu-vram-gb GPU_VRAM_GB
  --emergency-headroom-gb EMERGENCY_HEADROOM_GB
  --max-spill-gb MAX_SPILL_GB
  --min-tps MIN_TPS
  --critical-tps CRITICAL_TPS
  --live-ui {off,compact,full,graph,log}
  --behavior-probe      also run a synthetic 64k recall/structure/speed probe
                        (default on)
  --no-behavior-probe   skip the synthetic behavior probe; telemetry
                        validation will cover needle only
  --yes
  --mock
  --no-ranking-update   write the diagnostic run but skip rankings/model-card
                        refresh
  --separate-ranking    generate an isolated rankings-separate/<run-id> report
                        for this diagnostic profile
